gates.requiredScope: Final intended Feature-029 candidate has no whitespace error, missing intended file, placeholder, or forbidden path.
gates.rationale: The staged candidate, including new files, is the delivery unit.

gates.requiredScope: Feature-024, Feature-028, and Feature-029 evidence validators pass on the reviewed head.
gates.rationale: The new validator extends shared audit evidence infrastructure.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Audit datasets, validator code, or proof paths change.

gates.requiredScope: The full TuiVision solution passes in Release configuration.
gates.rationale: Shared test infrastructure and project-wide evidence references change.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any executable or project file changes.

gates.requiredScope: Core, Controls, Serialization, Compatibility, and Drivers.Console each retain at least 70 percent line coverage.
gates.rationale: The repository Constitution forbids merge below the five-assembly gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Coverage configuration, tests, or gate assemblies change.

gates.requiredScope: Generated documentation builds with zero warning or error for the learner-facing audit guide and status changes.
gates.rationale: Feature 029 adds learner-facing Markdown and navigation-visible content.

gates.requiredScope: The generated DocFX site passes the Playwright and Axe accessibility smoke path.
gates.rationale: DocFX completion requires the matching A11Y path.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Generated pages, navigation, templates, or A11Y tests change.

gates.requiredScope: Secrets, dependencies, generated output, protected source roots, external checkout, and runtime/API/package/example scope remain clean.
gates.rationale: The audit must remain publishable and read-only toward protected inputs.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Candidate paths or dependency manifests change.

gates.requiredScope: Five maintained agent surfaces agree that Feature 029 is complete, Feature 030 is next, and both Waves remain blocked.
gates.rationale: Shared agent and ordering guidance is a completion surface.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Agent guidance, Pflichtenheft, or processing order changes.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed head executes the repository Release test command on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows.
gates.rationale: Portable audit paths and the existing project gate require real multi-platform execution.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Workflow matrix or test command changes.

gates.requiredScope: Review and thread convergence is tracked directly in PR evidence rather than as executed-command evidence.
gates.rationale: The gate-evidence schema validates executed technical commands; review state is verified through GitHub APIs.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A future provider-neutral review-evidence schema is adopted.
